elffolk.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (3x): wool tunic, belted trousers, bushy braided beard.

elffolk2.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (2.9x): moss tunic, belted trousers, fur mantle, long hair.

innkeeper.desc: Envoy Kolbrun Hailstride (3x): slate wool tunic, belted grey trousers, white fur mantle, braided hair, Kolbrun's horn on a strap.

lanternseller.desc: Rimewife Solvi (2.8x): blue-grey wrap tunic, belted skirt over leggings, rune-glow braids, rune staff.

poolkeeper.desc: Brynja Hornwise (3x): leather apron over a tunic and belted trousers, rolled sleeves, hair in a bun.

shopkeeper.desc: Jarl Thyra Stonebrow (3.2x): rust tunic, belted trousers, bear-fur mantle, rune-iron circlet, long grey braids.

traveler.desc: generic wanderer: green cloak, rose scarf, satchel (player)

wispcatcher.desc: Skuli (2x, a giant kid): oversized rust tunic, rope-belted trousers, a goatherd's crook.

wildcaller.desc: Wildcaller (Midgard farmhand, mortal): blond mop, rust tunic, rolled sleeves, satchel, long hoe; warm hearth sparks

runeguard.desc: Runeguard (Shield-warden, mortal paladin brawler): chestnut braids, grey mail shirt and sleeves, tan leather tabard to the hip with a gold rune, dark belt, brown trousers, dark boots, round shield with glowing light runes, axe

seer.desc: Seer (Rune-reader, mortal): grey hood, short pale-grey tunic-robe to mid-thigh cinched with a rune-blue sash, dark trousers, tan boots, stitched rune, rune-stone pouch, rune-carved staff; rune glow

stormborn.desc: Stormborn (Child of thunder, demigod brawler): bulky build, storm-blue cloak, silver circlet, stone war-hammer; lightning

grovekeeper.desc: Grovekeeper (Child of the Vanir, demigod): moss-green hair, flower crown, leaf-and-moss mantle over a cream blouse, dark belt, grass-green skirt, mushroom charms; neon green heal

cinderknight.desc: Cinderknight (Ember-born, demigod brawler): ember-red jerkin over a pale shirt collar, one small plate pauldron, bracers, dark belt with a glowing ember buckle, charcoal trousers, brown boots, ember hair, ash cheek marks, greatsword with an ember edge

golem.desc: stone golem: mossy boulder body, amber rune seam and eyes, two-fist slam

wraith.desc: blue cold-fire wraith: hooded spectre with a cold-fire hem and tail, casts a cold-fire orb

skeleton.desc: skeleton swordsman: big skull under a dark rune helm, dark breastplate, notched sword

icegolem.desc: frost golem: the stone golem in pale ice, snowy shoulders, ice spikes, white rune light

skelmage.desc: skeleton mage: skull under a red hood, long gold-hemmed robe, crooked staff with a cold-fire orb

eldergolem.desc: Mossheart the elder golem (mini-boss): dark ancient stone, amber crystal crown, glowing gold runes, glow-flowers

runesentinel.desc: summon (Runeguard): a floating rune stone on a pillar of light

runewisp.desc: summon (Seer): a blue rune-wisp with an orbiting glyph

stormsprite.desc: summon (Stormborn): a storm-cloud sprite walking on lightning

sapling.desc: summon (Grovekeeper): a treant sapling with a vine whip

mushgolem_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the mushgolem with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

runesentinel_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the runesentinel with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

stormsprite_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the stormsprite with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

sapling_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the sapling with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

emberimp_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the emberimp with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

dwarftrader.desc: Grimsa the trader (3x): layered wool tunics, a wide belt hung with pouches, a fur cap-less braid.

nightmerchant.desc: Rime-Captain Hjordis Icejaw (3x): leather jerkin over a belted tunic, belted trousers, round shield on her back, spear. No plate.

gnome.desc: Ulfar Mossback in town (3x): moss-green tunic, patched belted trousers, moss on his shoulders, shy and gentle.

kolbrun.desc: Envoy Kolbrun Hailstride (3x): slate wool tunic, belted grey trousers, white fur mantle, braided hair, Kolbrun's horn on a strap.

jarl.desc: Jarl Thyra Stonebrow (3.2x): rust tunic, belted trousers, bear-fur mantle, rune-iron circlet, long grey braids.

ulfar_town.desc: Ulfar Mossback in town (3x): moss-green tunic, patched belted trousers, moss on his shoulders, shy and gentle.

rimewife.desc: Rimewife Solvi (2.8x): blue-grey wrap tunic, belted skirt over leggings, rune-glow braids, rune staff.

skuli.desc: Skuli (2x, a giant kid): oversized rust tunic, rope-belted trousers, a goatherd's crook.

goatwife.desc: Brynja Hornwise (3x): leather apron over a tunic and belted trousers, rolled sleeves, hair in a bun.

grimsa.desc: Grimsa the trader (3x): layered wool tunics, a wide belt hung with pouches, a fur cap-less braid.

rimecaptain.desc: Rime-Captain Hjordis Icejaw (3x): leather jerkin over a belted tunic, belted trousers, round shield on her back, spear. No plate.

gi_man.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (3x): wool tunic, belted trousers, bushy braided beard.

gi_woman.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (2.9x): moss tunic, belted trousers, fur mantle, long hair.

ulfar.desc: Ulfar Mossback (companion; 3x in town, 2.4x in combat): gentle giant, moss-green tunic, patched belted trousers, moss on his shoulders. cast = shield hug, attack = boulder toss.

frost_troll.desc: Frost troll (1.6x; gate foe at 2x): ice-blue hide, ragged tunic, belted rag trousers, tusks, throws ice chunks / swings an ice club.

ice_golem.desc: Ice golem (1.5x): translucent ice blocks round a glowing rune heart.

avalanche_golem.desc: Avalanche golem (1.8x): a snow-capped boulder that unfolds into a golem; attack = rolls as a ball.

rime_berserker.desc: Rime Berserker (elite, 1.8x): fur over a belted tunic, belted trousers, two ice axes, wild braids.

pet_flurry.desc: Flurry, the snow hare (Jotunheim pet): a white hare with long ears whose tips glow cold blue, a glowing tail puff and a faint chest glint; scampers on the ground, ears flat when she bounds (speed aura, finds hidden snow paths)

pet_flurry_safe.desc: Flurry, the snow hare (Jotunheim pet): a white hare with long ears whose tips glow cold blue, a glowing tail puff and a faint chest glint; scampers on the ground, ears flat when she bounds (speed aura, finds hidden snow paths)
